request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real food, glass, ceramic and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A DINNER plate of meat and vegetables. One white plate holds one grilled steak on the left half and a clear portion of cooked vegetables (carrots, broccoli and green beans) on the right half; a lit candle in a plain holder and a dark window behind the table show that it is evening on a dark wooden table, photographed from a little above. Everything named is sharp and clearly separate. Nothing else is on the table: no cutlery, no napkin, no other food, no hands, no people. No letters, words, numbers, logos, labels or brand marks anywhere.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
